name: Finance-group verified LINE mention
requiresDatabases: HOZO AM 2.0 Group Bindings with one finance binding, one canonical LINE 群組 ID, and a valid 成員對照 JSON field
Existing AM operational-memory processing_jobs store for durable source-notification identity binding

dataIsolation.guard: The caller supplies neither groupId nor userId. The route resolves both only inside the HOZO AM 2.0 tenant and reads mention identity solely from the uniquely selected finance binding page.

definitionOfDone: The finance push body requires a bounded mentionName present in text
Finance sourceNotificationId is required, stable per source event, fixed-format, and durably bound to normalized content
Finance retryKey is required, fixed-format, and cryptographically bound to the source id plus normalized payload
Caller-supplied groupId, userId, and unsupported fields are rejected
The finance binding is selected by exact canonical name across all Notion result pages
The LINE group id is read only from one canonical LINE 群組 ID rich-text value and must be C plus 32 hexadecimal characters
Exactly one member-map entry on the selected finance binding resolves the mention
Duplicate JSON keys plus missing, malformed, invalid, and ambiguous member mappings return non-2xx without a LINE push
The finance route passes one prevalidated textV2 payload to the existing LINE sender without a second mention transformation
Caller braces and an adjacent literal at-sign are normalized into exactly one textV2 mention marker, with the final JavaScript UTF-16 length capped at 5000 before binding
Responses and logs do not expose the resolved LINE user id
Delivery requires LINE HTTP 200 with a valid nonempty request id, or HTTP 409 with valid accepted-request evidence for the same content-bound payload; HTTP 202 and 204 remain uncertain
Source content, resolved route, provider retry seed, creation time, and delivery lifecycle are durable
Unverified sends retry only inside 23 hours; expired attempts and legacy succeeded rows without verified evidence require manual reconciliation without provider resend
Operational-memory pool initialization can recover after rejection and idle pool errors are handled without logging secrets
Rental records non-2xx or non-delivered results as notification failure
